title: Nvidia Shares Skyrocket as Jensen Huang Makes Stunning Return as CEO
snippet: Nvidia stock surged over 30% after the chip giant's board reversed course and reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, adding nearly $1 trillion in market capitalization.
content:
In a dramatic corporate turnabout, Nvidia announced Monday that co-founder Jensen Huang has been reinstated as chief executive officer and president, triggering a massive Wall Street rally that sent the semiconductor giant's stock soaring more than 30%.

The historic stock surge added nearly $1 trillion to Nvidia's market capitalization, marking its best single-day performance since May 2023. The market optimism quickly spread to allied AI infrastructure firms, with neocloud providers CoreWeave and Nebius both seeing their shares surge over 30% in Monday trading.

A Swift Reversal by the Board

The board's decision represents a sharp U-turn from just last week, when Nvidia Chair Harvey Jones reassured investors during the company's third-quarter earnings call that there were no plans to bring Huang back. Following further deliberations, however, the board confirmed it was satisfied with Huang's candor and vision for the company's future.

"The board believes Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers," Jones said in a statement. He also extended gratitude to CFO Colette Kress, who served as interim CEO during the leadership vacuum.

Navigating Controversy and Security Scrutiny

Huang originally stepped down on Nov. 12 following revelations regarding personal affairs, including an alleged relationship with Alice Huang, an executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed who was under suspicion for smuggling restricted Nvidia chips into China. The scandal raised immediate red flags in Washington over potential national security implications.

Nvidia confirmed Monday that after engaging with senior U.S. government officials, the board established that Huang's return poses no national security risks. Huang's comeback was also bolstered by high-profile political allies, including President Donald Trump, who praised the move on Truth Social.

Trump stated that the Attorney General confirmed the government possesses no evidence of illegal conduct by Huang, calling the executive a "Great Patriot and National Treasure" whose leadership is vital to the American economy.

"I am honored to return to Nvidia and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution," Huang said in a statement, thanking leadership, employees, and shareholders for their continued backing. "I can't wait to get back to work."
